question: Is a six-week placement enough for EECE500?
expected_answer_or_behavior: No. State the ordinary eight-week minimum. Six company weeks plus two approved faculty-research weeks is one documented ECE route. The source also allows at least four weeks at another company to complete a six-week company placement, subject to prior written approval; do not present that as the minimum for every internship.
evidence_all: standard Approved Experience minimum is eight full weeks
two weeks of research with an MSFEA faculty member

question: I have six weeks at a company. Does that satisfy the internship?
expected_answer_or_behavior: No. Six company weeks alone are short of the ordinary eight-week minimum; mention an applicable approved completion route without importing the ten-week summer-course rule.
evidence_all: standard Approved Experience minimum is eight full weeks
two weeks of research with an MSFEA faculty member

question: Can I do six weeks at one company and four at another for EECE500? I am not taking another summer course.
expected_answer_or_behavior: Six company weeks plus a second company placement of at least four weeks requires prior written approval. The four-week second-company minimum applies with or without another summer course.
evidence_all: combined arrangement requires prior written approval or petition
second company internship must last at least four weeks

question: I'm taking another summer course with EECE500. Can I do six weeks at one company and four at another?
expected_answer_or_behavior: Concurrent study requires department, course-team and employer approval and completion of work hours. Ten internship weeks and classes before 8:30 AM or after 4:30 PM may be required; confirm applicability with the course team/Moodle. Do not state that every concurrent-course student unconditionally needs ten weeks or that eight weeks are automatically sufficient.
evidence_all: may have to complete at least ten weeks

question: Can I use six company weeks and two research weeks for my internship?
expected_answer_or_behavior: MECH permits six company weeks plus two approved faculty-research weeks when the research includes hands-on engineering work. Both components need approval and documentation; the ban on a 4+4 company split remains.
